blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Despite Vice President Sara Duterte’s lawyers’ presentation of six witnesses to the impeachment trial in four days, the prosecution panel believes that the allegations raised under Article II have not been disputed. The group believes this situation is causing panic in the ranks of the defense team. Article II pertains to the alleged unexplained wealth and reported violations in the Statement of Assets, Liabilities and Net Worth. Prosecution spokesperson and Lanao del Sur Rep. Zia Alonto Adiong said in a press briefing on Thursday that the defense panel’s decision to withdraw the presentation of several witnesses may be a […]...
